svg.aria-label: Perfboard layout, 24 by 18 holes, component side and copper side. J1 BAT terminal at column 2 rows E and G; AM312 socket J3 at column 5 rows D to F; D2 from E7 to E11; R2 from E12 to E16; C1 at H15 (minus) and H16 (plus); R3 from J16 to N16; Q1 IRLZ44N gate J19, drain J20, source J21; J2 boost terminal at column 23 rows E and G. Copper: BAT+ along row B, GND along row Q, gate along column 16 and row J, switched minus from J20 to G23.
